title: Algebra base change realizes module tensor pullback and its unit
statement: Let j:Z→X be any morphism of schemes, a an adjunction tensorPullback j ⊣ pushforward j [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and B a commutative O_X-algebra sheaf [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Write U for commAlgebraSheafModule, and F=tensorPullback j ⋙ pushforward j. There exist a commutative O_X-algebra sheaf C, an algebra morphism p:B→C, and an O_X-module isomorphism e:F(U(B))≅U(C), such that U(p)=a.unit.app(U(B));e.hom. No grading, local freeness, closed immersion or coproduct hypothesis is used; e is only a module isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 0095 and 0096, inverse image followed by extension of scalars; Tag 09MS, the coefficient quotient on the direct-sum algebra

proof.text: Form the pushout D of r:j⁻¹O_X→O_Z and s:j⁻¹O_X→j⁻¹B in commutative ring sheaves. Let b and t be its two inclusions. Define C by pushing D forward with structure morphism j-sharp followed by j_*b, and p by the ring inverse-image unit followed by j_*t. Naturality of the unit, the pushout equation, and the ring adjunction identity show p is an algebra morphism. All data are constructed from the categorical pushout, not chosen from a mere existence theorem.

For any B.right-module G, inverse image commutes with restriction along B.hom: both underlying abelian sheaves are the same and their scalar actions agree by inverseImageOperation_ext, using restriction compatibility, inverse-image unit semilinearity and unit naturality. The identity section maps give inverseRestrictIso. Extending scalars carries this isomorphism to a change-of-rings isomorphism and its sheafification-unit formula follows from unit naturality. The scalar-action helper explicitly binds the arbitrary algebra B and uses B.right and B.hom in its signature; unlike the private affine helper, it does not specialize B to the structure algebra f_* O_U.

Apply sheafTensorPushoutCancellation to the constructed pushout and to the inverse image of the regular B.right-module. Apply inverseImageRegularExtension to identify extension along t of that inverse-image regular module with the regular D-module. Compose the inverse-restriction, pushout and regular-extension isomorphisms; push it forward. The resulting module is definitionally U(C). On sections the canonical tensor unit is θ(1 tensor η_Ab(x)); inverse restriction fixes the abelian representative, the pushout comparison sends it to θ_t(1 tensor η_Ab(x)), and regular extension sends it to t(η_B(x)). This is exactly U(p).

For the supplied adjunction a, let a₀ be the chosen canonical tensor pullback adjunction. Compose pushforward of leftAdjointUniq a a₀ evaluated on U(B) with the canonical comparison. Mathlib Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app and associativity give the asserted equality. All section and tensor calculations apply unchanged for zero rings and empty opens.
